name: Mayakkar Prehistoric Site
description: The Mayakkar Prehistoric Site is a fascinating glimpse into the lives of early inhabitants of Sri Lanka, located in the Jaffna District of the Northern Province. Archaeological evidence suggests that this area was inhabited as far back as the Neolithic period, approximately 3,000 years ago. Visitors can explore the ruins of ancient dwellings, tools, and artifacts that provide insights into the lifestyle of prehistoric people. The site also offers a unique opportunity to understand the cultural and religious practices of the time. The landscape around the site is dotted with numerous rock shelters and burial grounds, which are testament to the rich cultural heritage of the region. Visitors can take guided tours, engage in educational talks about the site’s history, and participate in hands-on activities such as crafting stone tools or learning about ancient farming techniques. The site is a must-visit for anyone interested in archaeology, history, and understanding the roots of human civilization in Sri Lanka.
activities: guided tours, educational talks, hands-on activities

name: Kadurugoda settelment site
description: Kadurugoda Settlement Site is a pre-historic archaeological site located in the Jaffna district of Sri Lanka’s Northern Province. This ancient settlement offers a glimpse into the lives of early inhabitants who thrived in this fertile area thousands of years ago. The site showcases remnants of prehistoric dwellings, tools, and artifacts that provide insights into the social, economic, and cultural practices of the people during that era. Visitors can explore the ruins, which include stone foundations and hearths, and learn about the significance of this location through guided tours. The site also features a small museum where visitors can view more artifacts and learn about the broader context of Sri Lanka’s prehistoric period. While the site itself is relatively small, it holds immense cultural value and is a must-visit for those interested in Sri Lanka’s ancient history and heritage.
activities: exploring ruins, guided tours, learning about prehistoric life

name: Kadurugoda Ruin
description: Kadurugoda Ruin is a historically significant stupa located in the Jaffna District of Northern Province, Sri Lanka. The stupa stands as a testament to the architectural prowess of ancient Sri Lankan builders, featuring intricate designs and a serene ambiance that attracts visitors from around the world. Visitors can explore the surrounding area, which includes several other archaeological sites and natural landscapes. The stupa’s peaceful atmosphere and historical significance make it a must-visit for those interested in Sri Lanka’s past. While the stupa itself is not particularly large, its cultural importance cannot be overstated. Visitors can learn about the religious practices and rituals associated with the site, and there are often guided tours available to provide deeper insights into the history and significance of Kadurugoda Ruin.
activities: exploring, photography, meditation

name: Buddhist ruins, Delf island
description: Buddhist Ruins on Delf Island is a serene and historically significant site located in the Jaffna District of Sri Lanka’s Northern Province. The site houses several ancient stupas, each with its own unique architectural style and historical significance.
